query: What is the average time complexity of quick sort?
passage:
## 4. Quick sort and counting sort

Quick sort picks a pivot, moves smaller values to its left and bigger to its right, then sorts each side. On average O(n log n), and it is what sort() in C++ is built on. Counting sort works when values are small integers: count how many times each value appears, then write them out in order. O(n + max value).

query: What does position i in a Fenwick tree store?
expect: the sum of a block whose length is the lowest set bit of i
passage:
## 2. The Fenwick tree (binary indexed tree)

A shorter trick for prefix sums with updates. Position i stores the sum of a block whose length is the lowest set bit of i ( i & -i ). Adding: climb with i += i & -i . Prefix sum: descend with i -= i & -i . Ten lines of code, used everywhere.
